reason: A Windows desktop wrapper that launches the DeepSeek Harness web GUI in a native window and adds local file upload and document text extraction support.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 封装为 Windows 桌面应用，并提供本地文件上传及文档文本提取功能。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop wrapper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with local file uploads and supported document text extraction.

capabilities: Starts and stops a local dsh web server process
Opens the dsh web GUI in a native desktop window
Selects or reuses local network ports
Installs an upload plugin into DSH configuration
Stores uploaded files locally and extracts text from supported documents
